name: Apple M2 Max 38-core (64GB), LM Studio/llama.cpp: Llama-3.3-70B 4-bit decode tok/s (Silicon Score measured)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Silicon Score Llama 3.3 70B model page + chip rows, cited by research-big-memory.md). M2 Max 38-core, 64GB unified memory (~400 GB/s): 8.8 tok/s on 70B 4-bit. 64GB fits a 70B Q4 only at low context. Decode scales almost perfectly with memory bandwidth on this class - 8.8 t/s is just under half the M1 Ultra's 12.6 t/s at 400 vs 800 GB/s.
notes: Gap-fill for the Oct-14 Phase-A ingest: research-big-memory.md listed this row in its Apple Silicon 70B table but no dedicated benchmark record existed (apple-m2-max accelerator was also missing - added in this pass). Used MacBook Pro M2 Max 64GB is the cheapest Apple ticket to a *loadable* 70B, but the 64GB ceiling means short context.
